integrity.proof_scope: All integer m at least two for the three-side-site theorem; all backbone lengths at least three and all nontrivial particle numbers for two-site minimality.
integrity.verification: Exact analytical proof with a reproducible finite diagnostic checker; numerical bisection is illustrative rather than a proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite closed, conserved-particle periodic ASEP with uniform backbone rates and equal tree outward-to-inward ratios greater than one.
The current ranking concerns one backbone bond and two specified side-site topologies; it does not address open-reservoir systems or all possible tree morphologies.
The known stationary measure and each individual backbone-current formula are expressly attributed to prior literature.
Publication-priority originality is qualified because a broader unlocated comparison theorem could subsume the explicit classification.
title: A unique topology-induced current reversal in a three-site-decorated exclusion ring
